sourceText:
Schedule 5 No Shooting Areas (Section 6)
Ganges
3 That portion of the Province of British Columbia in Ganges Harbour, Cowichan District, except organized territory, which is contained within the following described boundaries: All of that area known as Ganges Harbour below the high water mark lying north of a straight line running from Scott Point due West to the nearest point on the west shoreline of said harbour.
sourceVersion: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026
